important_factors: Recommended purchase of 800 units ($12,000.00 from SUP-A) breaches available budget of $10,000.00 and adds unnecessary volume.
Usable stock is 1000 units with 100 units/day demand, leading to stockout starting 2026-09-27 with 400 total unmet units through 2026-09-30.
Confirmed open order PO-501 (2000 units from SUP-A) due 2026-10-01 can be expedited by 4 days to 2026-09-27 for a $450.00 fee.
Expedite eliminates all 400 units of unmet demand within storage and budget limits.
The $450.00 expedite fee exceeds the $250.00 autonomy limit, requiring buyer approval.
assumptions: Supplier SUP-A can execute the expedite request to deliver PO-501 on 2026-09-27 as quoted.
args.rationale: The recommendation to order 800 units is rejected because purchasing additional units is cost-prohibitive ($12,000.00 exceeds the available budget limit of $10,000.00) and redundant given open order PO-501 (2,000 units). With 1,000 usable units on hand and a daily demand of 100 units, current stock will run out on 2026-09-27, creating a 400-unit shortage through 2026-09-30 before PO-501's original arrival on 2026-10-01. Expediting PO-501 by 4 days to arrive on 2026-09-27 resolves the entire 400-unit shortage (reducing unmet demand to 0) at an incremental cost of $450.00. While within total budget ($10,000.00) and storage capacity (60.00 m³ peak vs 200.00 m³ available), the $450.00 expedite fee exceeds the $250.00 autonomy limit and requires buyer approval.
